title: Prospectus: revise 'billing never changes access' and build lifecycle events, for the accepted lifecycle rule
description:
Outcome: Owner decision B (Ryan, 2026-11-08, accepted): past due for 14 days makes editing read-only with the public site up; cancellation deletes the tenant 30 days later, with export available throughout. That contradicts Prospectus's current decision 7 (kanbus-8e3174: billing never grants, disables or suspends an entitlement) and needs lifecycle events that do not exist yet (kanbus-6efecd). Ask in Prospectus: (1) revise kanbus-8e3174 so that a past-due period and a cancellation change the deployment's state automatically, with an operator override; (2) build kanbus-6efecd events for payment failed, past due reached, payment recovered, cancelled and reinstated, delivered at least once with an event id; (3) the event names the deployment (site id) as well as the Account. Papyrus consumes them in PPY-d7274f.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): Prospectus: docs/BILLING.md, kanbus-8e3174, kanbus-6efecd; Papyrus: the prospectus-events consumer (PPY-a1e75a part C), PPY-d7274f.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-lifecycle.feature (Papyrus side)):
Scenario: Fourteen days past due makes editing read-only
    Given alpha's Account has been past due for 14 days
    When Prospectus emits the past-due event for deployment "alpha"
    Then alpha's editors become read-only at their next token, and the public site stays up

Scenario: Paying restores editing
    Given alpha is read-only for non-payment
    When the payment-recovered event arrives
    Then editing returns at the next token

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-6d9a6d. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-bd1c6e.

Testing: Prospectus specs with its fake processor; Papyrus Behave with a fake event source.
Rollout: Prospectus decision change first (Ryan has accepted the rule), then events, then Papyrus consumer.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: a wrongful automatic suspension of a paying customer. Mitigation: 14-day period, email notices, operator reversal in one command, events idempotent by id.

Releasable on its own: yes, in Prospectus.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: changes: deployment state drives tenant claims.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
